parole.significato: A flat piece of coarse material used for wiping one’s feet, or as a decorative or protective floor covering.
parole.testo: Inherited from Middle English matte (“mat”), from Old English meatte (“mat”), from Late Latin matta (“mat made of rushes”), from Punic or Phoenician (compare Hebrew מיטה \ מִטָּה (mitá, “bed, couch”)).
